welcome_intro: This research project explores "{topic}" through AI-mediated interviews.
welcome_process: The interview is text-based and asynchronous. You may complete the interview at your own pace.
welcome_voluntary: Your participation is voluntary. The interviewer will not judge, teach, persuade, or evaluate your opinions. We are interested in understanding your experiences and perspectives.
welcome_message: Thank you for considering participation in this research project.
